about_the_game:
This DLC grants access to 10 songs including Touhou original "A Soul as Scarlet as a Ground Cherry"

Release is scheduled for August 21st, 2025.

  • A Soul as Scarlet as a Ground Cherry (Original Touhou Song)

  • New Arrangement by Tamaonsen

  • Flame of Nuclear (Dankagu Edit)

  • Sunlight Diamonds (Violet Delta Remix)

  • Bang Bang!

  • VAMPIRE MATE

  • The Replica Sneers

  • Night Falls ~ Evening Star LSDj Remix (Dankagu Edit)

  • Lunatic Princess

  • Who killed U.N.Owen

Check out the official page for details on the songs.
